bestiary.name: Blorb
bestiary.description: A small ball of caustic slime with legs slowly paces about.

bestiary.name: Glim
bestiary.description: A huge quadrupedal creature made of a green slime. Goo pours off its body in endless waves.

bestiary.name: Giant Rat
bestiary.description: A huge vermin, the size of a cat, with large yellow incisors.

bestiary.name: Cave Bat
bestiary.description: A small bat flits through the air.

bestiary.name: Shellback Beetle
bestiary.description: A huge, dog sized beetle with a hard, black shell prods its antenna at the ground.

bestiary.name: Needleling
bestiary.description: A dog sized creature with a large needle for a nose. It drips with a green liquid.

bestiary.name: Bear
bestiary.description: A bear walks along all fours, sniffing the ground for its next meal.

bestiary.name: Dire Bear
bestiary.description: A huge bear, of remarkable size. Each step shakes the ground.

bestiary.name: Tiger
bestiary.description: A prowling tiger, acutely aware of its target's vision, and how to stay out of it.

bestiary.name: Sabretooth Tiger
bestiary.description: A massive tiger with huge, sharp teeth growing from its mouth.

bestiary.name: Short-legged Saidribee
bestiary.description: A cat-sized bee hovers in the air, stinger prepared.

bestiary.name: Long-legged Saidribee
bestiary.description: A 5-foot bipedal creature. Its body is that of a dog sized bee, but with long, slender human-like legs.

bestiary.name: Saidribee Guardian
bestiary.description: A huge, quadrupedal bee-like creature, with large forelimbs that double as hands, and an intimidating stinger.

bestiary.name: Bombardier Beetle
bestiary.description: A huge lightning bug which has forsaken its wings for size. Its carapace emits a strange hum.

bestiary.name: Giant Beetle
bestiary.description: A giant beetle with buzzing wings hisses continuously.

bestiary.name: Unicorn
bestiary.description: A famous magical horse-like creature with one horn.

bestiary.name: Bicorn
bestiary.description: A terrible, brutish bull-like creature with two horns.

bestiary.name: Tricorn
bestiary.description: A famous magical horse-like creature with three horns.

bestiary.name: Quadricorn
bestiary.description: A terrible, brutish bull-like creature with four horns.

bestiary.name: Pentacorn
bestiary.description: A famous magical horse-like creature with five horns.

bestiary.name: Hexacorn
bestiary.description: A terrible, brutish bull-like creature with six horns.

bestiary.name: Heptacorn
bestiary.description: A famous magical horse-like creature with seven horns.

bestiary.name: Devil's Samara
bestiary.description: A large tree with razor-sharp, whirling seeds sprinkling down around it.

bestiary.name: River Drake
bestiary.description: A blue draconid, its scales quiver in anticipation of its next meal.

bestiary.name: Valta
bestiary.description: A deer made of moonlight shines in the darkness.

bestiary.name: Moonspawn
bestiary.description: A bear made of moonlight shines in the darkness.

bestiary.name: Killspawn
bestiary.description: A huge, lumbering ogre made of blades. Looking at it, you know it yearns for your death.

bestiary.name: Maulchild
bestiary.description: A large, child-like demon which seeks affection from all creatures.

bestiary.name: Hemogoblin
bestiary.description: A goblin made of blood.

bestiary.name: Hemogoblin Bloodmancer
bestiary.description: A goblin made of blood wearing a cloak, soaked through with his body-liquid.

bestiary.name: Hemogoblin Inventor
bestiary.description: A goblin made of blood carries a bag full of crystals and a map.

bestiary.name: Hemogoblin Mech
bestiary.description: A huge mechanical beast. The pinnacle of Hemogoblin warfare.

bestiary.name: Dryad
bestiary.description: An ordinarily peaceful creature, the flesh has twisted its mind into assisting it.

bestiary.name: Witch
bestiary.description: A whore whom has forsaken her humanity for devilish power.

bestiary.name: Troll
bestiary.description: A huge, brutish biped. It clumsily drags its knuckles along the floor, tearing off skin which rapidly replaces itself.

bestiary.name: Kelpie
bestiary.description: An infamous man-eating water horse, known for dragging its victims to the bottom of the ocean with its kelp like tentacles.

bestiary.name: Wendigo
bestiary.description: A cannibalistic human who has long since given themselves to the madness of the flesh. It looks starved.

bestiary.name: Vampire
bestiary.description: A creature of decadence and excess, who, having grown tired of wine and sex, turned to blood and murder.

bestiary.name: Banshee
bestiary.description: The eternal spirit of those women who seek shelter in the flesh from their terrible suitors. Her shriek means death.

bestiary.name: Phoenix
bestiary.description: A creature of beautiful flame and rebirth, twisted by the flesh. Despite its corruption, its resurrection still comes quickly.

bestiary.name: Yeti
bestiary.description: An abominable snowman, which freezes all who dare to come close.

bestiary.name: Chimera
bestiary.description: An infamous firebreathing creature with the head of a lion, goat and serpent.

bestiary.name: Cancer
bestiary.description: A terrible crustacean, with claws of force enough to crush metal.

bestiary.name: Ursa Minor
bestiary.description: The legendary bear-child of Anavani. Her incestuous brother sleeps soundly, till she calls for aid with her dying breath.

bestiary.name: Ursa Major
bestiary.description: The elder bear-child of Anavani. His claws are unstoppable, and his maw means death.

bestiary.name: Minotaur
bestiary.description: A terrifyingly huge and stupid brute, with the head of a bull and the body of an ogre.

bestiary.name: Dragon
bestiary.description: The most famous of all flesh creatures, a terrifying beast of scale and flame.

bestiary.name: Sphinx
bestiary.description: The immortal Sphinx cares only for the chase, and stands guard eternal.

events.name: Lesser Ichor-Fish
events.description: A fish made of hardened ichor swims through the terrible liquid.

events.name: Ichor-Fish
events.description: A fish made of hardened ichor swims through the terrible liquid.

events.name: Greater Ichor-Fish
events.description: A fish made of hardened ichor swims through the terrible liquid.

events.name: Lesser Ichor-Shark
events.description: A shark made of hardened ichor swims through the terrible liquid.

events.name: Ichor Shark
events.description: A shark made of hardened ichor swims through the terrible liquid.

events.name: Greater Ichor Shark
events.description: A shark made of hardened ichor swims through the terrible liquid.

events.name: Lesser Ichor Leviathan
events.description: A colossal creature made of hardened ichor swims through the terrible liquid.

events.name: Ichor Leviathan
events.description: A colossal creature made of hardened ichor swims through the terrible liquid.

events.name: Greater Ichor Leviathan
events.description: A colossal creature made of hardened ichor swims through the terrible liquid.

events.name: Ichor Fish
events.description: A golden fish born from Mercuria's well. It can act only in ichor; successful bites there restore 2% of its maximum health. This legacy creature retains the strength it had when it emerged.

events.name: Bastidion
events.description: A large, stationary fungus which emits clouds of toxic gas.
